chunks: They said: "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will be expelled (from the city)."

key_terms.لُوطُ: Lot (peace be upon him), the prophet

ai.seo_question: What was the ultimatum given to Prophet Lot by his people?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this ultimatum from the people of Lot underscores the tension between prophetic authority and societal conformity, illustrating how prophets were often marginalized for challenging entrenched moral decay. The threat of expulsion reflects a common pattern in Quranic narratives where the 'people of the house' are tested by their community's refusal to accept divine guidance. This verse serves as a reminder of the resilience required of prophets and believers when facing social ostracization for upholding truth.
